summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it received a Nasdaq Compliance Letter on July 7, 2026, confirming it has regained compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement (Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had been notified of the deficiency on January 22, 2026, and was given until July 21, 2026 to cure. Compliance was achieved because the closing bid price of its Class A ordinary shares was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from June 22 to July 6, 2026. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
